fields.description: Master switch. When off, no outbound calls are made and no inbound payloads are processed (still logged if Log Only).
fields.label: TCB Integration Enabled

fields.description: Off = no calls, no logs. Log Only = no live calls, all attempts logged. Live = real calls to TCB.
fields.label: Outbound Mode

fields.description: When an unpaid Sales Order is cancelled, send a Reference Decline call to TCB so the control number cannot accept a payment.
fields.label: Decline Reference on SO Cancel

fields.description: What to do if the TCB Decline call fails. Allow Cancel and Flag = cancel the SO anyway and mark the registry. Block Cancel = throw and prevent the SO cancellation.
fields.label: Decline Failure Policy
fields.options:
Allow Cancel and Flag
Block Cancel

fields.description: Off = ignore IPNs. Log Only = log but never create Payment Entry. Apply Payment = create Payment Entry on matched control number.
fields.label: Inbound Mode

fields.description: When enabled and inbound mode is Apply Payment, IPN callbacks immediately create the Payment Entry. Otherwise the callback is logged for manual review.
fields.label: Auto-Apply Callback Payments

fields.description: Comma or newline separated list of TCB source IPs allowed to call the IPN endpoint. Checked against X-Forwarded-For. Leave empty to allow all (not recommended in production).
fields.label: Allowed IP Addresses

fields.description: How far back the daily reconciliation job pulls TCB rows.
fields.label: Reconciliation Lookback Days

fields.description: TCB provides pre-signed URLs that already contain the partner secret in the path. Paste the complete URL from TCB. There is no separate API Key.
fields.label: TCB Endpoints (Full URLs)

fields.description: Full URL for registering a control number (reference). E.g. https://partners.tcbbank.co.tz/public/api/reference/XXXX. Request is form-urlencoded (POST).
fields.label: Reference Create URL

fields.description: Full URL for declining / cancelling a reference. E.g. https://partners.tcbbank.co.tz/public/api/reference/decline/XXXX. Request is JSON (POST).
fields.label: Reference Decline URL

fields.description: Full URL for the reconciliation pull. E.g. https://partners.tcbbank.co.tz/public/api/reconciliation/XXXX. Request is form-urlencoded (POST).
fields.label: Reconciliation URL
IPN Callback URL (Give This To TCB)

fields.description: Public URL where TCB should POST instant payment notifications. Share this with TCB integration team. Populated from the site's public URL.
fields.label: IPN Callback URL
IPN Callback Hint
fields.options: TCB will POST JSON to this URL. The endpoint accepts the standard TCB IPN envelope {status, statusDesc, param:{...}}. Restrict access by adding TCB's source IP to the Allowed IP Addresses field above.
